# kargo_project_config (Data Source)

Retrieves information about a Kargo ProjectConfig.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "kargo_project_config" "example" {
  project = "example-project"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project` (String) Name of the Kargo Project.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Name of the Kargo Project.
- `promotion_policies` (String) Promotion policies in JSON format.
- `webhook_endpoint` (Attributes List, Sensitive) Webhook endpoints generated by Kargo. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--webhook_endpoint))
- `webhook_receivers` (String) Webhook receivers in JSON format.

<a id="nestedatt--webhook_endpoint"></a>
### Nested Schema for `webhook_endpoint`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) Name of the webhook receiver.
- `path` (String, Sensitive) Path generated for the webhook receiver.
- `url` (String, Sensitive) Complete URL to give to the service sending the webhook.
